notes.title: Steam Deck update now live!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year and a huge thanks to everyone who tested the beta branch release ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1638330/announcements/detail/3908625644169663542?snr=2___]see here[/url]), the updates are now live in the main branch.
If you've ever wanted to try tuna sashimi on the go, now's your chance!

notes.title: Darius Cozmic Collection Arcade Update
notes.notes:
Hello Darius fans!

Today's update comprises of the following:
[list][*]Added a screen adjustment function to Darius Gaiden
[*]Added ability to choose which screen to flip when using multiple monitors
[*]Added settings when using Direct Input controllers
[*]Added ability to adjust the window with a controller
[*]Fixed other minor issues[/list]
Enjoy, 
The Taito Steam team.
